title: FAERS "signal detection" invents ROR / PRR / IC025 and labels the method as MGPS
invented: Pharmacovigilance disproportionality statistics. Reporting Odds Ratio, Proportional Reporting Ratio and IC025 (the lower bound of the 95% credibility interval of the Information Component) are standard, defined quantities that require a 2x2 contingency table against the whole FAERS background. Here ROR is `1.0 + percentage/10`, PRR is `1.0 + percentage/15`, and IC025 is literally the constant 0.5 or -0.5. `signalDetected` — a regulatory safety-signal determination — is `percentage > 5` within the 100-record page just fetched. The response then names the method as MGPS, the Bayesian data-mining algorithm FDA actually uses; no MGPS, no Bayesian shrinkage, and no background frequency computation exists anywhere in the file.

Any authenticated tenant user gets the numbers plus a fabricated `regulatoryImplication` telling them whether to consider a REMS evaluation or a label update.
